text:
maria: Quick sync  we need final speakers, a tight run-of-show, and a fallback for the Benchmarks webinar. who owns the live demo?
aj: I can run the live demo, 6-7m, three configs (fast/balanced/high).
sam: I'll record a fallback deep-dive and upload. fallback mandatory. :grimacing:
elaine: I'll cover product + routing decision matrix (3-4m). drafting a 2-line abstract now.
maria: Abstract options: 1) Cost-first benchmarking 2) Routing & caching for predictable latency 3) Picking model variants. pick one.
elaine: Option 2 — ties to routing.
aj: Draft landing abstract: "Live benchmarks + routing patterns to get predictable latency and lower inference spend."
maria: Bios (2 lines) pls.
sam: "Sam K  Solutions Engineer. Focus: demo ops and inference cost optimization."
aj: "AJ P  Runtime Engineer. Focus: latency, batching, quantization."
elaine: "Elaine W  Product Lead, Routing. Focus: SLO-driven routing & resilience."
maria: Rehearsal slots: Tue 11am PT, Wed 2pm PT (preferred), Thu 5pm PT.
aj: Wed 2pm PT works.
sam: Wed works; I'll upload fallback by Tue EOD.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder set: "Benchmarks webinar rehearsal" Wed 2:00 PM PT.
ops-bot: Upload fallback to /shared/marketing/webinars/benchmarks/fallback.mp4 before Tue 23:59 PT.
sam: Uploaded at 2798765400: https://drive.redwood.co/webinars/benchmarks/fallback.mp4
aj: Run-of-show draft:
````
0:00-0:30 host intro
0:30-3:30 product + why routing matters (elaine)
3:30-10:00 live demo (aj) - 3 configs, p95, cost
10:00-12:00 fallback / recorded deep-dive (sam)
12:00-25:00 live Q&A
````
maria: Tighten demo intro to 20s and include a copy-paste routing YAML slide.
aj: Sample snippet I'll include:
```
routes:
  - priority: low-latency
    model: rdm-7b-q8
  - fallback: rdm-34b-ptx
```
elaine: We'll show telemetry (per-route latency & token breakdown).
maria: Marketing needs: 30-word social blurb and a tweetable stat. ideas?
aj: Tweetable: "Routing + quantization cut median latency ~2.8x and lowered per-call token spend ~30% in our tests."
sam: Social blurb: "Live demo & benchmarks: routing, caching, and model choices to reduce latency and cost. Live Q&A."
maria: Great. I'll update calendar and landing page. thanks team! :tada:
